data.one_liner: Turn any widget into frosted glass or Apple-style liquid glass with a single asGlass() call.
data.what_it_does: Converts any standard Flutter widget into a glassmorphic element using a backdrop blur, tint, and frosted noise texture. It also supports experimental Apple-style liquid glass effects with edge refraction and rim lighting.
use_when: You want to implement glassmorphism design or Apple-style liquid glass effects on UI elements.
You need to blur background content behind cards, bottom sheets, or navigation bars.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based continuous squircle shapes instead of standard circular or elliptical corner arcs.
You have many overlapping glass elements without grouping, which can severely impact scrolling performance.
strengths: Extremely simple API accessed via an extension method (.asGlass()).
Supports performance optimization for lists and multiple instances via BackdropGroup.
Safe fallback to plain blur on web and Skia renderers when fragment shaders aren't available.
weaknesses: Liquid glass refraction and rim features require Impeller and are not fully functional on the Skia renderer or web.
Multiple unoptimized glass widgets on screen can hurt scrolling performance.
Corners use circular or elliptical arcs rather than Apple's continuous squircle shape.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.29 or newer. Optional precaching can be done via LiquidGlass.precache() in main().
